text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down over 3.5% in the past day, signaling a broad pullback across the majors rather than isolated weakness. The Fear & Greed index at 30 reflects genuine concern, with sentiment deteriorating notably over the past week, while Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59.2% suggests capital is rotating into the largest asset rather than fleeing crypto entirely. Volume remains substantial at $212 billion, indicating this is an active selloff rather than apathetic decline.
